# Retake

> Demo-as-code for coding agents: a YAML manifest in, a product walkthrough video out. Rerun the demo instead of re-recording it.

An agent that was handed this repository should read README.md first — its "If you are a coding agent" section is the setup sequence — then AGENTS.md (the CLI loop, manifests, logins, what trips agents up) and skill/SKILL.md (the method Claude Code loads as a skill).

- README.md: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/glebbogachev00/retake/main/README.md
- AGENTS.md: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/glebbogachev00/retake/main/AGENTS.md
- skill/SKILL.md: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/glebbogachev00/retake/main/skill/SKILL.md
- demos/example.yaml: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/glebbogachev00/retake/main/demos/example.yaml
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/retake-demos
